how_to_use: This index is the entry point for the comfy-headless knowledge base. Pick entries by 'profile' (image, video, 3d, audio, inference, metadata) and 'kind': 'profile-guide' pages carry the verified facts and traps for one profile; 'workflow' entries are runnable API-format reference graphs with placeholder inputs (see each file's 'placeholders'); 'knowledge-page' entries are cross-cutting (addressing/typing rules, retrieval contract, traps); 'node-facts' is the machine-readable pack/provenance registry. Read the profile guide before editing a graph; every class_type in these graphs was verified against the live ComfyUI catalog on the date above.
